Use proactively on every user turn (search memory before answering and persist the exchange after), and whenever the user references past context, their identity, preferences, or history, or asks to remember, recall, modify, forget, or correct something (e.g., "who am I", "what do I like", "remember that...", "forget X", "you got it wrong"). Also use when uploading, listing, or deleting knowledge base files.
